import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get all air quality stations with their coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lon, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
""")
stations = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total stations: {len(stations)}")
print(stations[['id', 'name_en']].to_string(index=False))

# Compute pairwise distances using PostGIS, then find nearest neighbor for each
query = text("""
WITH station_coords AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, coordinate
    FROM air_quality_station
),
pairwise AS (
    SELECT 
        a.id AS station_id,
        a.name_en AS station_name,
        b.id AS other_id,
        b.name_en AS other_name,
        ST_Distance(a.coordinate::geography, b.coordinate::geography) AS distance_m
    FROM station_coords a
    CROSS JOIN station_coords b
    WHERE a.id != b.id
),
nearest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (station_id)
        station_id,
        station_name,
        other_name AS nearest_neighbor,
        distance_m
    FROM pairwise
    ORDER BY station_id, distance_m ASC
)
SELECT * FROM nearest
ORDER BY distance_m DESC
""")
nearest_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("\nAll stations ranked by nearest-neighbor distance (descending):")
print(nearest_df.to_string(index=False))

# Store top 3
top3 = nearest_df.head(3)
isolated_1_name = top3.iloc[0]['station_name']
isolated_1_distance = float(top3.iloc[0]['distance_m'])
isolated_2_name = top3.iloc[1]['station_name']
isolated_2_distance = float(top3.iloc[1]['distance_m'])
isolated_3_name = top3.iloc[2]['station_name']
isolated_3_distance = float(top3.iloc[2]['distance_m'])

print(f"\nTop 3 most isolated stations:")
print(f"1. {isolated_1_name}: {isolated_1_distance:.0f} m")
print(f"2. {isolated_2_name}: {isolated_2_distance:.0f} m")
print(f"3. {isolated_3_name}: {isolated_3_distance:.0f} m")
